texts:
This 3D character follows your cursor, and there is no model file behind it. The figure is procedural, built in code, down to the blink.

It lives on the Avatar Artifact, a page with one job: render one avatar from a link, with no app around it. Move a mouse, drag a finger or press the arrow keys and it turns to look. Copy embed hands you a single iframe for any website.

Point it at your own agent with ?agent= and that avatar renders instead, resolved live from the agent's public record. ?model= takes any GLB from an allowed host, and anything else is refused with a sentence saying why, not a blank frame.

three.ws/avatar-artifact

It is deliberately the smallest viewer we ship. The 3D engine is inside the bundle, so a site that embeds it never picks up a script from a third-party CDN, and a hidden tab suspends the render loop instead of burning the host page's GPU.
